phonePrivacy.title: Your phone number stays private
phonePrivacy.description: It's only shown on a marketplace listing or roommate post when you turn on "Show my number" for that post. You can change that on each listing.

download.title: Download my data
download.description: Get a JSON copy of your profile, listings, roommate posts, conversations, the messages you sent, and your saved dorms.

success.title: Your data is downloading
success.description: Look for the JSON file in your downloads.

retention.title: How long we keep your data
retention.description: Your account information is kept for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, we remove your profile, listings, messages, and associated content from our active systems within 30 days. Some information may remain in encrypted backups for up to 90 days before it's purged. Aggregate, non-identifying analytics may be kept indefinitely.

activity.note: Password changes and two-factor updates will appear here as they happen.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Add a second step at sign-in with a code from an authenticator app (like Google Authenticator or 1Password). You'll also get one-time backup codes in case you lose your device.
twoFactor.enrollQrDescription: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.qrCodeAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.manualKeyPrefix: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
twoFactor.backupCodesDescription: Each code works once if you lose your authenticator. This is the only time they're shown, so store them somewhere safe.
twoFactor.disableDescription: Enter a current code from your authenticator app to confirm. Your backup codes will also be deleted.
twoFactor.enabledDescription: You'll be asked for a code at sign-in.
twoFactor.copyManual: Select and copy the codes manually.
